payload.name: Status-seeking behavior in ovulating women
payload.fact: Women near ovulation seek positional goods to improve their social standing, specifically when doing so improves relative standing compared with other women.

provenance.title: Money, Status, and the Ovulatory Cycle
provenance.quote_or_locus: Findings from three studies show that women near ovulation seek positional goods to improve their social standing. Additional findings reveal that ovulation leads women to pursue positional goods when doing so improves relative standing compared with other women but not compared with men
